{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column from string to float, handling any non-numeric values
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of revenue for completed orders
revenue_stats = completed_orders['revenue'].describe()

# Check how many orders have zero revenue
zero_revenue_count = (completed_orders['revenue'] == 0).sum()

revenue_stats, zero_revenue_count"}
